Indirāpariṇayanāṭaka

th cent. A. D. See Ind. Cult. III. p.. 153-54 an. Gode, Studies in Ind. Lit. History, I. p.. 151-165.

Indudūta

spoken by Indra (Purandara, Sahasrākṣa); actual Text Beg. indrAkSI nAma sA devI etc. Some mss. assign it to Skandapurāṇa, some to Rudrayāmala, an. some to Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa.
America 1542. Bomb.

. TD. XX. Sup. nos. 584. 1009.
Pt.. often: (1) With Śivakavaca in Gr. Script, Madras, 1878. (2) in Telugu Script, Masulipatam, 1913. (3) Kalyan, Bombay, 1901 (20 stanzas, with Nyāsa etc.). (4) Lahore, 1923. (5) Bṛhatstotra Muktāhāra, Pt. I. no. 108, 1923. (6) Bṛ. St. Ratnā., Bhārgavapustakālaya, Banaras, 1937, p.. 224-7. (7) Bṛ. St. Ratnahāra, Guj. News Press edn., Pt. I. p.. 406-8.

stotra, being ch. 13 of Brahmatāntrika. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 11 (2 mss.).
